dictionary_format: Ahmadreza Samadi analysis dictionary; custom JSON format, not an asserted external schema standard
ai_assistance: Prepared with AI assistance and separately reviewed against source metadata and build logic.

dataset.scope: Selected whole metropolitan areas in 50 states/DC from ACS2024 1-year; not the 393-metro HUD-study universe.

missing_values.derived: Blank CSV cell means unavailable. Never replace it with zero. Real zero counts or zero shares remain zero.
missing_values.raw: Source integer tokens retained verbatim. Negative sentinels/non-count tokens must not be treated as counts or silently coerced to zero. This fixed released snapshot has nonnegative estimate/MOE tokens.
missing_values.status: Read status before interpreting derived cells. No percentage margin of error has been calculated.

limits: Shares describe the source-tabulated gross-rent-to-household-income ratio, not current asking rent, property yield or investment rank.
All 11 source estimate/MOE pairs retained; derived percentage MOE and statistical significance are not established.
A field dictionary does not certify the original survey, authenticate a modified receipt or establish a real company result.
Original dictionary and checker are MIT; underlying Census statistics retain the source status and exceptions discussed in README.md.

fields.name: geo_id
fields.meaning: Exact GEO_ID from the source geography file; keep as text, including its geography-vintage marker.

fields.name: cbsa_code
fields.meaning: Five-character CBSA code from the source geography file; preserve text and leading zeros.

fields.name: metro_name
fields.meaning: Published whole metropolitan-area label, not a property or city-only boundary.

fields.name: survey_year
fields.meaning: ACS 1-year source year, not download year or current market year.

fields.name: status
fields.meaning: Analysis availability status. This fixed released snapshot contains only ok. The builder can also report unavailable source estimate or zero computable denominator.

fields.name: renter_units_total
fields.meaning: Total renter-occupied housing units; not a count of people or only cash-rent units.

fields.name: not_computed_units
fields.meaning: Units for which the source ratio is not computed; retained separately, not treated as zero burden.

fields.name: computable_units
fields.meaning: Denominator for the two threshold percentages.

fields.name: rent_30plus_units
fields.meaning: Units in the published 30.0%-or-more bins.

fields.name: rent_50plus_units
fields.meaning: Units in the published 50.0%-or-more bin; a subset of rent_30plus_units.

fields.name: rent_30plus_pct
fields.meaning: Share of computable units at 30.0% or more, rounded to six decimals; not a 0–1 fraction.
fields.blank_if: computable_units is zero or source estimate unavailable

fields.name: rent_50plus_pct
fields.meaning: Share of computable units at 50.0% or more; nested inside the 30% group. Do not add these percentages.
fields.blank_if: computable_units is zero or source estimate unavailable

fields.name: not_computed_pct_all_renters
fields.meaning: Share of all renter-occupied units with a not-computed ratio; its denominator differs from the two burden percentages.
fields.blank_if: renter_units_total is zero or source estimate unavailable
